question:
An engineer needs to create a new user in the local user database on Cisco UCS Fabric Interconnect. The user needs permissions to change the following configuration inside UCS Manager version 3.1:
- vNIC and vHBA profiles
- Fan speed and power redundancy profile of UCS Manager
Which two roles must be assigned to a user to achieve this goal? (Choose two.)
theory: Cisco UCS Manager RBAC uses discrete built-in roles rather than one all-powerful admin login. vNIC and vHBA profiles are logical service-profile objects, so managing them requires the Server Profile role (read-write to logical server-related operations), while fan speed and power-redundancy settings are power-management operations that fall under the Facility Manager role. Because neither role alone covers both areas, both must be assigned together to satisfy the stated requirement while still following least-privilege principles. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 19 - Securing UCS Management, User Roles)
